segments.name: Virtual technology services
segments.description: Provides virtual technology services and digital asset development to entertainment production enterprises.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in a single operating segment and has one reportable segment, which includes all activities related to activities consist of virtual technology services, digital asset development and others.

revenueModel.text: Entertainment production enterprises pay for virtual technology services and for copyright-licensed digital assets.
revenueModel.evidence: Through the establishment of copyright licensing agreements, we confer production rights, adaptation rights, and sublicense rights of both licensed copyrights and digital assets upon entertainment production enterprises.
